name: schema
summary: Show the Schema DB: types, document kinds and commands; with names, each one's fields, units and defaults (ara schema Light entity.create)
usage: ara schema [OPTIONS] [NAMES]...

args.name: [NAMES]...
args.doc: Types, commands or methods to describe

options.name: --out <OUT>
options.doc: Write reflection.json and JSON Schemas into this directory

options.name: --root <ROOT>
options.doc: Project root (default: the nearest ancestor with ara.project.json)

options.name: --author <AUTHOR>
options.doc: Who protocol commands are attributed to: human or agent:<name> (default: ARA_AUTHOR, else the agent running this CLI, else human)
